## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D Stardew Valley-style farming game featuring two characters: Andy and Rifqi.

## Requirements
- Build now without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Check screenshots using small JPEGs at no more than 1280px wide, reading only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created a self-contained browser game concept named Willowbrook with local two-player controls, farming goals, and responsive UI.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html` with the game’s HTML, CSS, canvas map drawing, and initial game state/functions through `drawTree`.

### Active
- Finish the JavaScript game implementation in `index.html`; continue from `drawTree` and add game loop, controls, interaction, and HUD logic.
- Validate the game in a browser and inspect a screenshot.

### Blocked
- An `edit` tool call intended to append the remaining game logic failed because it required `path` but was called with `file`; no appended code was applied.

## Next Move
1. Continue editing `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`, appending the remaining JavaScript after `drawTree`.
2. Ensure controls support Andy with WASD, Rifqi with arrow keys, planting/watering/harvesting, HUD updates, day progression, and mobile controls.
3. Run the game and verify it renders and is playable; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Main game file; currently contains the page and partial canvas game implementation.

## Important Context
- The game defines a 30×18 canvas tile world, 20 crop plots, and initial player positions for Andy and Rifqi.
- The previous attempted append contained proposed objective and interaction functions but did not change the file; it must be recreated or implemented independently.

  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser

  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
